posts.text:
Would Jimmy Carter have supported the SAVE America Act? 

His own bipartisan election commission offers a pretty good answer.

It recommended voter ID, proof of citizenship before registration, and an end to political operatives collecting absentee ballots.

The SAVE America Act is commonsense legislation.
posts.summary: Supports voter ID and citizenship verification, opposes mail-in ballots and ballot harvesting

The bipartisan Carter-Baker Commission laid out how to prevent voter fraud.

The Democrats’ behavior is designed to maximize voter fraud.
